title: Projection 솔로 #004 · wide hip narrow · 프로젝션 만화경 · 힙 팝 · 갤러리 · 오네에갸루

ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle.
